data.title: Unlock Crix & Decker Through Crafting
data.summary: Craft two new War Robots as you progress through the levels.
data.meta_description: Craft two new War Robots as you progress through the levels.
data.content:
Pilots, it's time to add two new War Robots to your hangar! 

As of the latest update, Decker and Crix, the highly anticipated War Robot Spiders, are now accessible through the crafting progression system. Players who have reached the necessary levels can craft these powerful robots to take their combat strategies to the next level.

Here’s when you can unlock their components:

Decker

  • Level 203 - Decker Shoulder
  • Level 206 - Decker Chassis
  • Level 209 - Supply Surge Cycle Gear
  • Level 212 - Hefty Weapon
  • Level 215 - Decker Torso

Crix

  • Level 218 - Crix Shoulder
  • Level 221 - Crix Chassis
  • Level 227 - Stormpike Weapon
  • Level 230 - Crix Torso

Unleash the power of Decker and Crix today and take your combat skills to the next level!

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:
